articles.title: Correspondence: the numbers behind it
articles.brief: Why written landlord communication matters — notices must often be in writing to count; source: statute notice requirements.

articles.title: Correspondence: what it does and how to use it
articles.brief: What Correspondence does — helps the tenant write and send landlord letters (repair requests, notices) with the right content. Example: a repair-request letter citing the duty-to-maintain statute.
